findings.value: Time Out reported in November 2025 a new Saturday market of six art and craft stalls outside E Pellicci on Bethnal Green Road, planned to run until 20 December.

evidence.quote: a new Saturday market has launched in Bethnal Green, east London, with six stalls selling an array of artsy goods
in front of legendary cafe E Pellicci on Bethnal Green Road
It’ll be open every Saturday from 9am to 4pm, until December 20.

notes: Only the 2025 pop-up market was found. It is an eight-week Saturday market, not clearly the same as a permanent 'Bethnal Green Market'; the editor should check the match before publishing. The Tower Hamlets council news page (November 2025) gives 10am to 4pm hours, Time Out gives 9am to 4pm; the programme or facts researcher should settle hours. Any status change would be news older than six months, so none is proposed.
